issues.issue: The disbursement category rules put noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The report prints it under the Public Works heading (and the statement's Public works 78,430), so streets/highways is defensible. A review note is present.

A large broad 'Local' group in the Road Fund is recorded as other. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows only 31,803 of public works charges for services, so most of it is unexplained (possibly reimbursements or FEMA money). It is far above budget and should be confirmed. The General Fund 'Local' 1,347,433 (detail[2]) is likewise recorded as other.
